Plugin.Name: Tasqs
Plugin.Overview:
Turn unRAID notifications into tasks in Tasqs (tasqs.com). Adds a "Tasqs" agent to Settings -> Notifications -> Agents, next to Discord and Pushover: paste the webhook URL from your Tasqs profile, tick the importance levels to forward, done.
A disk running hot becomes a task due today with the alert's details; when unRAID reports that it "returned to normal", the task completes itself. Repeats of the same alert are folded into one task, so a disk that complains every minute makes one task, not sixty. Optional HMAC signing and an IP allowlist on the Tasqs side mean a leaked URL alone can add nothing.
One bash script, no dependencies beyond what unRAID ships (bash, curl, openssl). Requires a Tasqs Premium or Power User plan.
